name: notice-board-apiary-sow-v1
description: ⭐ THE reference-v17 GAME, KEPT AS A CONTROL (14/09/2026). The shipped game of 13/09/2026 with the Apiary Notice Board's S12 power, "Sow 2 cards from your hand onto your buildings", before Dean ruled in the retext "Grow a building using the top card of any deck" (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild'). One leaf, so on the shipped base it reproduces reference-v17's rules exactly; a paired arm against the new default reads the retext as a delta. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ HAND LIMIT PINNED 24/09/2026: the simulator's hand bound moved from 7 to 10 (rules.turn.handLimit is an INSTRUMENT bound, never a table rule, CLAUDE.md 2.3; the move is reasoned in rules.json's meta.notes). This overlay predates that move and replays a game recorded under the bound of 7, so rules.turn.handLimit 7 is pinned here BY NAME and it still replays its own game.
